messages.content: Baltimore email landed. Presenter check-in is at a side entrance before regular registration, and I have to bring the demo bag with me. Can you sanity-check BWI to the hotel and make sure Sunday still works?

Yes. With the demo bag, I would make rideshare the primary plan. Light rail is cheaper, but it adds platform time, walking downtown, and bag handling right at Thursday commute time. Rideshare may be slower in traffic, but it keeps the bag contained. Taxi line is the backup if app pricing gets silly.
The email says presenter side door is open 6:30 to 8:30 and the workshop room can be accessed after 7. Do I go hotel first or straight there?

Straight to the venue is cleaner. You land at 6:14, so with a 6:40-ish rideshare you should reach the side entrance around 7:20 to 7:40. That lets you badge in and do room setup before the 8:30 cutoff. Hotel-first adds check-in and a second ride, and risks missing the setup window.
Okay, but will the hotel be fine with late arrival? Also recheck the room basics.

I checked the reservation notes: late arrival after 8:30 is fine. The queen studio suite is still attached to the booking; coffee maker and fridge/kitchenette are listed; indoor pool and fitness room are confirmed. Still no hot tub listed.
Good. Put the timing in plain English. I don't want to over-optimize this.

Plan: BWI to the convention-center side entrance by rideshare, not light rail. Do presenter check-in and workshop-room setup first, then rideshare to Homewood. If the rideshare estimate jumps over about an hour or surges badly, use the airport taxi line rather than dragging the demo bag to light rail.
Sunday changed slightly: presenter wrap-up now ends at 11:30. Is the 2:40 flight still sane with checkout?

Yes. Check out before the morning session, leave bags with the hotel or conference bag check, and aim to leave the venue around 12:15. Your BWI-TPA nonstop at 2:40 still has a reasonable buffer. I’ll keep rideshare as the airport plan both ways, with light rail only as a backup if you are no longer hauling the demo bag.

messages.content: New Madison request. A children’s outpatient clinic wants me Monday-Tuesday, May 19-20. I have a late-morning thing in Tampa that Sunday and need to be at the clinic by 7:15 Monday. Can you compare Madison airport versus Milwaukee and look at hotels? No booking yet.
I can. What is the earliest you can realistically be at TPA Sunday, and would you be willing to rent a car if Milwaukee is the better flight play?
I can probably be inside TPA by 1:15. If I fly into Madison I’d rather rideshare. If I fly into Milwaukee I’d rent. The Tuesday end time is fuzzy; they mentioned a debrief but not a hard stop.

Got it. I’ll compare around a post-1 p.m. Tampa departure, a 7:15 Monday clinic arrival, and the possibility that Tuesday runs long. The basic split is: Madison airport reduces driving but has fewer flight choices and more connection risk; Milwaukee opens better fares and timing, but adds the rental-car drive to Madison.
Group it by practicality, not cheapest. I teach Thursday, not Wednesday, so I have a little room if the return needs breathing space.

Practical flight read: option 1 is Milwaukee with an early-evening arrival, roughly TPA after 2:30 and MKE around 5:45 to 6:30, then a 75-90 minute drive to Madison. Best balance if you are okay driving before it gets too late. Option 2 is Madison via a hub, usually arriving closer to 8:30 or 9:30 and costing more; less driving, but a missed connection is harder to recover from. Option 3 is the cheap late Milwaukee arrival, but I would drop it because starting the drive near 10 p.m. before a 7:15 clinic start is not a good trade.
I can handle the Milwaukee drive if I’m not starting it at 10 p.m. What hotels are viable?

Three to compare. Closest clinic hotel: easiest morning location, about a few minutes from the clinic, but recent feedback is uneven; no hot tub, and mini-fridges appear to be by request rather than guaranteed. Downtown suite hotel: better rated, queen studio, coffee maker, mini-fridge, indoor pool, hot tub, and fitness room listed; trade-off is a 20-minute morning drive and likely paid parking. West-side business hotel: about 12-15 minutes from the clinic, solid recent reviews, coffee maker and mini-fridge listed, pool and fitness room listed, but I do not see a hot tub.
The clinic-adjacent one is the place they sent. What does uneven feedback mean?

Recent comments mention inconsistent housekeeping, front-desk follow-through, and hallway noise. The rating is hovering just under 4, while the downtown and west-side options are above 4.2 in the recent sources I checked. The bigger caveat for your stay is that the refrigerator setup is not guaranteed and there is no hot tub.
That’s exactly the kind of thing that irritates me before an early clinic day. The downtown drive worries me, though.

For a 7:15 arrival, the downtown suite means leaving around 6:30 to 6:35. The drive itself is usually under 25 minutes, so the real question is parking and which door is open that early. If the clinic confirms staff parking near the therapy gym and access by 7:00, downtown is fine. If parking is vague, the west-side business hotel becomes the safer compromise.
What would you rank first right now?

Most practical today: downtown suite, if the clinic confirms early parking and access, because the room and recovery setup are the most predictable. Second: west-side business hotel, less commute friction and still reliable, but missing a hot tub. Third: the clinic-adjacent hotel, useful only for location; I would not book it unless they guarantee the mini-fridge and the recent review pattern does not bother you.
Return home: could I fly Tuesday after the debrief?

Maybe, but it is not attractive. Madison Tuesday evening options are expensive and mostly connect late, getting you into Tampa close to midnight. Milwaukee Tuesday requires the drive after training; if the debrief slips past 2:30, the airport buffer gets thin. Wednesday afternoon from Milwaukee looks calmer and cheaper, and it would still get you home well before Thursday teaching.
If Wednesday afternoon is the better plan, I’m okay with one extra night. I just need to know what the clinic must answer.

Ask them: is the Tuesday debrief a hard 2:30 p.m. finish or could it run later; can your demo equipment stay onsite Monday night and until you leave Tuesday; where exactly should you park, and is that lot open before 7:00 a.m.; which entrance should you use for the therapy gym, and can you unload close to it.
Add whether I need to bring mats or if they have tables. That affects bag size.

Yes, add mats, plinths or treatment tables, display or projector input, extension cord, and whether there is a lockable place for the demo bag. Bag size matters for the airport choice too: the bigger the bag, the more Milwaukee plus rental car beats connecting into Madison and then relying on rideshare.
Send me a clean note I can forward. No booking yet.

Forwardable note: Madison clinic-training planning, May 19-20. Travel leaning: fly Tampa to Milwaukee Sunday afternoon/early evening, rent a car, and drive to Madison before it gets late. Madison airport is closer but has fewer choices, higher fares, and more connection risk. Return leaning: Wednesday afternoon from Milwaukee unless the clinic confirms an unusually early and firm Tuesday finish. Hotel leaning: downtown suite hotel, because it lists a queen studio, coffee maker, mini-fridge, indoor pool, hot tub, fitness room, and stronger recent ratings; caveat is the 20-minute morning drive and parking cost. Backup hotel: west-side business hotel, shorter drive and reliable basics, but no hot tub shown. Clinic-adjacent hotel is location-only for now; caveats are mixed recent reviews, no hot tub, and refrigerator only by request. Questions for clinic: confirm Tuesday debrief hard stop; confirm equipment storage Monday night and Tuesday; confirm early parking location and entrance for a 7:15 arrival; confirm unload access near the therapy gym; confirm mats/plinths/treatment tables; confirm projector/display input and extension cord; confirm lockable storage for the demo bag.

messages.content: Madison replied. Debrief will be done by 2:30 Tuesday, equipment can stay onsite, and they have parking by the therapy gym with the door open at 6:55. Let’s book. I’m leaning Milwaukee and the downtown suite unless you see a trap.

No trap with those answers. Milwaukee is the cleaner routing now: better Sunday arrival, better Wednesday afternoon return, and the rental car solves the demo-bag issue. The downtown suite is also the stronger hotel choice since the clinic parking and early entrance are confirmed.
Give me the exact plan and caveats before I approve it.

Proposed plan: fly Sunday May 18 TPA-MKE via Atlanta, 2:35 p.m.-5:54 p.m.; rent a standard car and drive to Madison, arriving at the hotel around 8:00. Return Wednesday May 21 MKE-TPA via Atlanta, departing 1:20 p.m. and arriving Tampa 6:35 p.m. Main fare is about $342, with seat selection. Hotel: downtown suite hotel, May 18-21, queen studio, coffee maker, mini-fridge, indoor pool, hot tub, fitness room, about $189/night before tax. Caveats: you are still doing the Milwaukee-Madison drive Sunday evening, hotel parking is about $18/night, and Monday/Tuesday mornings require a 6:30-ish departure.
Any reason to still use Madison airport?

Only if avoiding the drive is worth paying more and accepting weaker timing. The Madison options I see still either arrive later Sunday or make Tuesday return unpleasant. Since you are staying until Wednesday and have confirmed clinic parking, Milwaukee is more practical.
Then Milwaukee. Use a fare that lets me pick seats, not basic. Window seats if available. And book the suite, not the clinic hotel.

I can do that. Main cabin has window seats open on all four legs right now. The hotel is cancellable until two days before arrival. Estimated all-in before meals: flights about $342, hotel about $645 with tax before parking, rental about $184 before fuel/tolls. Ready for me to book?
Approved. Book the flights first.
Flights booked: Sunday May 18 TPA-ATL-MKE, 2:35 p.m.-5:54 p.m.; Wednesday May 21 MKE-ATL-TPA, 1:20 p.m.-6:35 p.m. Seats are set as windows: 16A, 12F, 15A, and 18F. Main cabin fare, not basic.
Book the downtown suite too. Queen room, not doubles.

Hotel booked for May 18-21: downtown Madison suite hotel, queen studio suite. Booking details confirm coffee maker, mini-fridge, indoor pool, hot tub, and fitness room. Plain caveats: paid parking, about a 20-minute clinic drive, and breakfast is not something I used as a deciding factor here.
And the rental car. Add the clinic details so I don’t have to dig through email.

Rental car booked: standard car from MKE, pickup Sunday May 18 at 6:15 p.m., return Wednesday May 21 by 11:30 a.m. Trip note added: clinic parking is by the therapy gym, door opens at 6:55 a.m., arrive by 7:15, debrief ends by 2:30 Tuesday, and equipment may stay onsite Monday night through Tuesday. Final caveats: leave Madison by about 9:45 Wednesday for the airport, and leave the hotel around 6:30 on clinic mornings.
